answer: An identity must be at least 6 epochs old on the ripple ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the lotus checkpoint rather than self-declared, the plume audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm therefore means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
